notices.title: Grantsville City Council Truth in Taxation Public Hearing Agenda
notices.agenda_text:
PUBLIC NOTICE:

The Grantsville City Council will hold a Truth in Taxation Public Hearing on Wednesday, August 5, 2026 in person at 429 East Main Street, Grantsville UT 84029 and electronically via Zoom beginning at 7:00 pm. 

The agenda is as follows: 

ROLL CALL 

AGENDA: 

1.	*Public Hearing Item: Consideration of Resolution 2026-59 approving a property tax increase, and levying the property tax rate for fiscal year 2027

                 *The public may make oral comments by participating either in-person at Grantsville City Hall or electronically via Zoom (login instructions can be found below or at www.grantsvilleut.gov)
                    Written comments may be submitted to the City Recorder at afairbourne@grantsvilleut.gov before and during the meeting. Written comments will be included in the public record and
                    will not be read aloud.
                 
                   Oral comments will have a three-minute time limit per interested party.

2.	Adjourn


Alicia Fairbourne
Grantsville City Recorder

notices.title: Notice of Proposed Tax Increase and Public Hearing
notices.agenda_text:
NOTICE OF PROPOSED TAX INCREASE
GRANTSVILLE CITY

     Grantsville City is proposing to increase its property tax revenue.

     The Grantsville City tax on a 563,000 residence would increase from $438.77 to $460.76, which is $21.99 per year.

     The Grantsville City tax on a 563,000 business would increase from $797.77 to $837.74, which is $39.97 per year.

     If the proposed budget is approved, Grantsville City would receive an additional $110,832 in property tax revenue per year as a result of the tax increase.

     If the proposed budget is approved, Grantsville City would increase its property tax budgeted revenue by 4.98% above last year's property tax budgeted revenue excluding eligible new growth.

     Grantsville City invites all concerned citizens to a public hearing for the purpose of hearing comments regarding the proposed tax increase and to explain the reasons for the proposed tax increase. You have the option to participate in the public hearing in person or virtually.


PUBLIC HEARING

     Date/Time:     Wednesday, August 5, 2026   7:00 PM MST
     Location:        Grantsville City Hall
                              429 East Main Street
                             Grantsville, UT 84029
     
To obtain more information regarding the tax increase, citizens may contact Grantsville City at 435-884-3411 or visit www.grantsvilleut.gov. Instructions for virtual participation in the public hearing will be available at www.grantsvilleut.gov no later than 24 hours before the public hearing is scheduled to begin.

notices.title: Notice of Ordinance Adoption
notices.agenda_text:
NOTICE OF ORDINANCE ADOPTION

PUBLIC NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that at the regular Grantsville City Council Meeting held on July 15, 2026, the Grantsville City Council adopted Ordinance 2026-26, which amends Chapter 7 of the Grantsville City Code relating to the City's Cross Connection Control Program by updating definitions, adding a definition for Dual Source Connection, and requiring reduced pressure principle assemblies for dual source connections. The ordinance also requires the removal of any noncompliant dual source connections to protect the public water system from potential contamination.

Complete copies of the adopted ordinances are available for review at the Grantsville City Recorder's office during regular business hours and online through the City's website at https://grantsville.municipalcodeonline.com/book?type=orddoc#name=2026 and the Utah Public Notice Website at https://www.utah.gov/pmn/sitemap/publicbody/1840.html.

Alicia Fairbourne
Grantsville City Recorder

Published and posted on July 16, 2026 in accordance with UCA § 10-3-711

notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing
notices.agenda_text:
GRANTSVILLE CITY
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING
FISCAL YEAR 2026 FINAL AMENDED BUDGET


PUBLIC NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Grantsville City Council will hold a Public Hearing on Wednesday, June 17, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. for the purpose of receiving public input regarding the proposed Fiscal Year 2026 Year-End Budget Amendments and Fiscal Year 2026 Year-End Budget.

The Grantsville City Council will also consider adoption of Resolution No. 2026-45, approving the Fiscal Year 2026 Year-End Budget Amendments and adopting the Fiscal Year 2026 Year-End Budget.

The public hearing will be held in person at Grantsville City Hall, located at 429 E. Main Street, Grantsville, Utah 84029, and electronically via Zoom.

Public comments are welcome and may be provided in person during the meeting, or electronically using the following information:
Meeting URL: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/4358843411
Dial-In: 1-253-215-8782
Meeting ID: 435 884 3411

Written comments may also be submitted to the City Recorder, Alicia Fairbourne, at afairbourne@grantsvilleut.gov. All written comments will be distributed to the City Council and entered into the public record. To ensure consideration, written comments must be received no later than 12:00 p.m. (noon) on the day of the meeting.

Copies of the proposed Fiscal Year 2026 Final Amended Budget and proposed resolution may be reviewed during regular business hours at Grantsville City Hall or online at the Grantsville City website and the Utah Public Notice Website.

DATED this 10th day of June, 2026.
Alicia Fairbourne
Grantsville City Recorder
